evidence: The precursor is delivered to the chamber by Ar bubbling from a precursor pot heated to 50 °C through gas delivery lines that are heated to 80 °C. The saturated precursor dosing time is 6 s at 7.5 mTorr (inset of Fig. 1), whereas saturation for the O plasma step was reached within 4 s at 5.3 mTorr and 100 W plasma power. Purge times using Ar were 6 s and 3 s after the precursor dose and plasma exposure steps, respectively.
